description: A white blocky bench/chair-like piece sits on the bed in front of you, with a couple of small white connector parts nearby. The left hand stays planted on the main bench piece to steady it as the right hand reaches in from the right, picks up a small connector, aligns it with the top-right slot of the bench, and presses it down into place before letting go; the bench remains a left-hand object while the connector is briefly a right-hand object.
